newsitem.title: USA: Catalytica sets stockholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Catalytica sets stockholder rights plan.

text.p: Catalytica Inc said Friday its board of directors adopted a stockholder rights plan.
Shareholders of record on November 29 will receive a dividend of one preferred shares purchase right for each share of Catalytica common stock held.
The rights would become exercisable if a person or group acquired 20 percent or more of Catalytica common stock or launched a tender offer for that purpose.

One right will entitle stockholders to buy one-thousandth of a share of the company's Series A participating preferred stock at an exercise price of $25.00. The company may redeem the rights, which will expire on October 23, 2006, at $0.001 per right.
